text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is here!
It's a special period that's perfect for rigorous training!

While some students were visibly on edge,
Matikanetannhauser was—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: When it comes to traveling on the bus, it's gotta be this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thrilling☆ Umapyoi Word Association Game!
Yeah-!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Pyoi pyoi♪
When you think 'summer', you think 'hot'!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: When it comes to "hot," that means "sauna"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~. Hehe,
this game is quite difficult, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The trick is not to think about it!
It's all reflexes—just jump and *pyoi*!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Is 'Pyoi' just a reflex to you~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
For example, when you think of a "sauna"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, no, it's coming back, it's coming back.

Carrying the lively Umamusume,
the bus slowly headed toward the training camp.
